sentences.en: The weather in Europe can be unpredictable because it's so close to the Atlantic Ocean.
sentences.zh: 欧洲的天气可能会不可预测，因为离大西洋很近。

sentences.en: We're planning a vacation on the coast of Maine, right by the Atlantic Ocean.
sentences.zh: 我们计划去缅因州海岸度假，就在大西洋边上。

sentences.en: The Suez Canal connects the Mediterranean Sea to the Atlantic Ocean.
sentences.zh: 苏伊士运河将地中海与大西洋连接起来。
